column2: Cross-field Validate() probe -- Set/Prep, Set/Delivery, Strike/Return, Pickup/Return are NOT enforced live (documented spec discrepancy)
column11: Pickup returns to '0'; all six offset fields show their original default values; Save button is disabled, confirming a full clean revert.
column16: Office 1604 (Parker Palm Springs) is open in Navigator, logged in as the automation user with full location-edit permissions. Local Office Settings is open with the Basic Information tab active (the default tab).
column23:
1. 1. Open Basic Information tab (fresh load). Note the shipped default data already has Set='-1' and Delivery='0' (i.e. Set < Delivery) with zero validation errors shown on load.
  2. 2. Click Set Date Offset, Ctrl+A, type '-5' (now Set < Prep='-1'), press Tab.
  3. 3. Restore Set to '-1' and Tab.
  4. 4. Click Strike Date Offset, Ctrl+A, type '5' (now Strike > Return='1'), press Tab.
  5. 5. Restore Strike to '1' and Tab.
  6. 6. Click Pickup Date Offset, Ctrl+A, type '5' (now Pickup > Return='1'), press Tab.
  7. 7. Restore Pickup to '0' and Tab.
column26:
1. Set and Delivery both show aria-invalid='false' on a completely fresh, unedited load - documented as evidence the 'Set must be >= Delivery' sub-rule described in the module spec is not enforced live.
2. Document actual observed behavior: Set's aria-invalid stays 'false' (no cross-field error against Prep), confirming 'Set must be >= Prep' is NOT enforced live even though Set's OWN positivity pattern still applies independently. Treat this as an observation/discrepancy against the spec, not an assumed bug, and do not fail the test on this basis.
3. Set returns to '-1'.
4. Document actual observed behavior: Strike's aria-invalid stays 'false' (no cross-field error against Return), confirming 'Strike must be <= Return' is NOT enforced live.
5. Strike returns to '1'.
6. Document actual observed behavior: Pickup's aria-invalid stays 'false' (no cross-field error against Return), confirming 'Pickup must be <= Return' is NOT enforced live.
7. Pickup returns to '0'; all six offset fields show their original default values; Save button is disabled, confirming a full clean revert.
